sources.entry: Kawa - Better input source switcher for macOS.

summary.one_liner: Kawa is a macOS input source switcher that lets you assign your own keyboard shortcuts to switch between input sources.
summary.what_it_does: Kawa is a macOS app for switching keyboard input sources (keyboard layouts and input methods) using user-defined shortcuts. The README describes it only at that level, with a demo section that has no content in the text provided. It can be installed through Homebrew Cask or by downloading a prebuilt Kawa.zip from Releases and moving Kawa.app to Applications. The README also covers building from source: dependencies are fetched with Carthage (carthage bootstrap), then the project is opened in Xcode. The README notes a known macOS Carbon library bug where switching via TISSelectInputSource does not work well with complex CJKV input sources.
use_cases: switch keyboard layouts with a hotkey on macOS
switch between Chinese, Japanese, Korean or Vietnamese input sources
install a menu-bar-style input switcher via Homebrew
build a macOS input source switcher from source
how_to_run: Alternatively: download Kawa.zip from Releases, unzip it, and move Kawa.app to Applications
carthage bootstrap (then open the project in Xcode)
notable: User-defined keyboard shortcuts for switching input sources
caveats: Known macOS Carbon bug: switching via TISSelectInputSource does not work well with complex CJKV input sources
Building from source requires Carthage and Xcode
